violations.why: The ISR can preempt after the task sets v_timber=&v_kelp and repoint it to its own local. The task's *v_timber at line 30 then goes through the ISR's pointer instead of v_kelp.
The ISR can change v_timber between the task's two dereferences at lines 30 and 31. The two stores can then go to different targets.
v_tundra and v_indigo both point to v_vessel. The ISR can read it through v_tundra between the task's two writes and see the intermediate value 2.
